summary: HeapBuffer::realloc computed its stored capacity before clamping the allocation size to MIN_HEAP_SIZE. Shrinking into the gap above MAX_SIZE therefore recorded a smaller capacity than allocated, causing incorrect capacity reporting and potentially undefined behavior during subsequent deallocation or reallocation. The fix computes the stored capacity after clamping. The unit test added by this fix checks that the stored capacity equals MIN_HEAP_SIZE. This plan reverses only that implementation correction; no tests were run.
